the development of a highly crystalline oriented thin film with an anionic inorganically modified metal-organic framework.
the development of novel metal-organic frameworks and their applications as functional materials.
the synthesis of a highly crystalline oriented thin film of an inorganic pillar metal-organic framework.

the anionic pillar ligand is a promising tool to construct a new class of crystalline oriented metal organic frameworks.
